Register isolated ARGENTUM C4 manual compile-only preflight [skip ci]

Exactly one dispatch-only workflow addition. Implementation pinned to 33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6. Main is unprotected with no required checks or rulesets at verified readback; skip marker prevents unrelated main push CI. No production or existing workflow changes.

+name: ARGENTUM C4 cold compile only 20261015
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      approval:
+        description: Exact source-bound C4 compile-only acknowledgement
+        required: true
+        type: string
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: argentum-c4-cold-compile-only-20261015
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  cold-compile:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      max-parallel: 2
+      matrix:
+        revision: [R5, R6]
+    steps:
+      - name: Fail-closed original and approval gate before downloads
+        env:
+          APPROVAL: ${{ inputs.approval }}
+          WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = GodaPupa/argentum-batshit-test
+          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch
+          test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/infra/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015
+          test "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1/1
+          test "$WORKFLOW_REF" = GodaPupa/argentum-batshit-test/.github/workflows/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015.yml@refs/heads/infra/argentum-c4-cold-compile-20261015
+          test "$APPROVAL" = C4_COMPILE_ONLY_ONCE_33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/dispatch-commit.txt"
+          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/run-identity.txt"
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
+        with:
+          ref: '33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6'
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Verify pinned implementation before toolchains
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 33e67f71931a1feaf335b1520be6ddba33e0c2b6
+          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = ed87a9c5ea6a60d968ee0856095b593a614f3816
+          cd qualification/c4-preflight
+          sha256sum -c SOURCE_SHA256SUMS
+          cp SOURCE_SHA256SUMS "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/implementation-SHA256SUMS"
+          cp "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence/dispatch-event.json"
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@cf277c60eb25467037889841efdb72551f06f6c3
+        with:
+          distribution: microsoft
+          java-version: '21'
+      - name: Install exact official Just
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" https://github.com/casey/just/releases/download/1.59.0/just-1.59.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
+          echo "409044617b6f06517c1035e55ca38c8c856ff8b650e41bc2aa1ef82d5903a23e  $RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
+          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin"
+          tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/just.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin" just
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/just-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Compile frozen variant only
+        env:
+          C4_REVISION: ${{ matrix.revision }}
+        run: python3 qualification/c4-preflight/preflight.py
+      - name: Seal complete or partial evidence
+        if: ${{ always() }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/c4-evidence"
+          if ! test -f result.json; then printf '%s\n' '{"status":"INCOMPLETE","reason":"preflight did not finish"}' > result.json; fi
+          find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        if: ${{ always() }}
+        with:
+          name: argentum-c4-${{ matrix.revision }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/c4-evidence
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+"""Receive original bounded payment repair; green is not acceptance."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json,zipfile,tempfile,hashlib,subprocess,os,sys
+H=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;P=json.loads((H/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

+def receive():
+    pins=json.loads((H/'PINS.json').read_text());m=json.loads((H/'metadata.json').read_text());run=m['run'];jobs=m['jobs']['jobs'];a=m['artifact']
+    assert run['id']==pins['run'] and run['head_sha']==pins['validation'] and run['workflow_id']==pins['workflow_id'] and run['path']==pins['workflow']
+    assert run['head_branch']==pins['branch'] and run['run_attempt']==run['run_number']==1 and run['event']=='push' and run['status']=='completed'
+    assert len(jobs)==1;job=jobs[0]
+    assert job['id']==pins['job'] and job['run_id']==pins['run'] and job['run_attempt']==1 and job['status']=='completed'
+    assert a['name']==pins['artifact_name'] and not a['expired'] and a['workflow_run']['id']==pins['run'] and a['workflow_run']['head_sha']==pins['validation']
+    for key,parent in [('source',P['base']),('validation',pins['source'])]:
+        assert m[key]['sha']==pins[key] and m[key]['tree']['sha']==pins['tree' if key=='source' else 'validation_tree']
+        assert [p['sha'] for p in m[key]['parents']]==[parent]
+    assert m['main']['sha']==P['main']
+    assert sorted(f['filename'] for f in m['source_delta']['files'])==sorted(P['source_delta'])
+    assert [f['filename'] for f in m['validation_delta']['files']]==[pins['workflow']]
+    data=(H/'original.zip').read_bytes()
+    assert len(data)==a['size_in_bytes'] and 'sha256:'+sha(data)==a['digest']
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(H/'original.zip') as z:
+        assert z.testzip() is None;names=[n for n in z.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')]
+        assert len(names)==len(set(names)) and all(not n.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(n).parts for n in names)
+        raw={n:z.read(n) for n in names}
+    manifest=json.loads(raw['MANIFEST.json'])
+    assert set(manifest)==set(raw)-{'MANIFEST.json'} and all(sha(raw[k])==v for k,v in manifest.items())
+    b=json.loads(raw['BINDING.json'])
+    for k in ['source','tree','validation','validation_tree','workflow','workflow_blob']:assert b[k]==pins[k]
+    assert b['run']==str(pins['run']) and b['attempt']==b['run_number']==1
+    assert blob(raw['WORKFLOW.yml'])==pins['workflow_blob']
+    for n,h in pins['protocol_files'].items():assert sha(raw['protocol/'+n])==h
+    assert json.loads(raw['protocol/PROTOCOL.json'])==P
+    for label in ['initial','pre-behavior','final']:
+        assert raw[label+'/TRACKED.diff']==b''
+        for path,h in {**P['bindings'],**P['protected']}.items():assert sha(raw[label+'/source/'+path])==h,(label,path)
+        for path,h in P['blob_bindings'].items():assert blob(raw[label+'/source/'+path])==h,(label,path)
+    normal=raw['initial/source/'+P['handler']]
+    forms={'normal':normal}
+    for name,m in P['mutants'].items():
+        body=normal
+        for c in m['changes']:
+            assert body.count(c['old'].encode())==c['count']
+            body=body.replace(c['old'].encode(),c['new'].encode())
+        assert sha(body)==m['sha256'];forms[name]=body
+    errors=[];gates={}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+        root=Path(td)
+        for n,body in raw.items():p=root/n;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(body)
+        sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'protocol'))
+        from reports import stage
+        for name in P['stages']:
+            try:
+                variant=name.removeprefix('compile-') if name.startswith('compile-') else name
+                assert raw[name+'/FORM.kt']==forms.get(variant,normal)
+                gates[name]=stage(root/name)
+            except Exception as e:errors.append(dict(stage=name,error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)))
+    try:
+        timing={name:json.loads(raw[name+'/TIMING.json']) for name in P['stages']}
+        assert all(v['started_ns']<v['ended_ns'] for v in timing.values())
+        assert max(timing[n]['ended_ns'] for n in P['stages'] if n.startswith('compile-')) < min(timing[n]['started_ns'] for n in P['stages'] if not n.startswith('compile-'))
+        assert all(timing[a]['ended_ns']<=timing[b]['started_ns'] for a,b in zip(P['stages'],P['stages'][1:]))
+    except Exception as e:errors.append(dict(stage='order',error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)))
+    if 'FAILURE.txt' in raw:errors.append(dict(stage='collector',error=raw['FAILURE.txt'].decode()))
+    state='RECEIVED_EARLY_PAYMENT_REPAIR_FULL_COMPATIBILITY_PENDING' if not errors and run['conclusion']==job['conclusion']=='success' else 'ORIGINAL_FAILURE_RECEIVED_NOT_ACCEPTED'
+    receipt=dict(pins,state=state,artifact=a['id'],artifact_bytes=len(data),artifact_sha256=sha(data),manifest_entries=len(manifest),gates=gates,gate_errors=errors,feature_acceptance=False,full_compatibility=False,card_registration=False,official_games=0,official_seeds=0,precision_reserved=2)
+    (H/'VERIFIED_RECEIPT.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(state=state,errors=errors)))
+if __name__=='__main__':receive()

+from pathlib import Path
+import json,re,collections,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+P=json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name('PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+
+def reports(raw, variant):
+    expected_classes={P['control_class']:P['classes'][P['control_class']]} if variant in P['mutants'] else P['classes']
+    assert len(raw)==len(expected_classes)
+    expected=collections.Counter((c,n) for c,names in expected_classes.items() for n in names)
+    rows=[];summary_failures=0
+    for data in raw.values():
+        root=ET.fromstring(data);cases=root.findall('testcase');rows+=cases
+        assert int(root.get('tests'))==len(cases)
+        assert root.get('errors')=='0' and root.get('skipped')=='0'
+        summary_failures+=int(root.get('failures'))
+    assert collections.Counter((r.get('classname'),r.get('name')) for r in rows)==expected
+    assert not any(r.find('error') is not None or r.find('skipped') is not None for r in rows)
+    witnesses=P['mutants'][variant]['witnesses'] if variant in P['mutants'] else {}
+    failed={r.get('name'):r.find('failure') for r in rows if r.find('failure') is not None}
+    assert set(failed)==set(witnesses),(variant,sorted(failed),sorted(witnesses))
+    assert summary_failures==len(failed)
+    for name,f in failed.items():
+        w=witnesses[name]
+        assert f.get('type')=='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError',(name,f.get('type'))
+        frame=re.search(r'ActivatedPhyrexianPaymentControlTest\.kt:(\d+)',f.text or '')
+        assert frame and int(frame.group(1))==w['line'],(name,frame.group(1) if frame else None,w['line'])
+        for token in w['contains']:assert token in (f.get('message','')+'\n'+(f.text or '')),(name,token)
+    return dict(cases=len(rows),passed=len(rows)-len(failed),failures=len(failed),errors=0,skips=0,witnesses=witnesses)
+
+def stage(folder):

+from pathlib import Path
+import json,os,subprocess,hashlib,shutil,time
+from reports import stage
+ROOT=Path.cwd();HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'manual-activation-payment-repair-r1-evidence'
+P=json.loads((HERE/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text());sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
+TARGET=ROOT/P['handler'];NORMAL=TARGET.read_bytes();FORMS={'normal':NORMAL}
+for name,m in P['mutants'].items():
+    b=NORMAL
+    for c in m['changes']:
+        assert b.count(c['old'].encode())==c['count'];b=b.replace(c['old'].encode(),c['new'].encode())
+    assert sha(b)==m['sha256'];FORMS[name]=b
+
+def save(p,b):p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
+def bind(label):
+    source=os.environ['SOURCE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',source+'^{tree}')==os.environ['SOURCE_TREE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',source+'^')==P['base'] and git('rev-parse','HEAD^')==source
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',source,'HEAD')==os.environ['WORKFLOW']
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',P['base'],source).splitlines()==sorted(P['source_delta'])
+    assert git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')==P['main']
+    assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')
+    for p,h in {**P['bindings'],**P['protected']}.items():
+        b=(ROOT/p).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==h,p;save(OUT/label/'source'/p,b)
+    for p,h in P['blob_bindings'].items():
+        assert git('hash-object',p)==h,p;save(OUT/label/'source'/p,(ROOT/p).read_bytes())
+    save(OUT/label/'TRACKED.diff',subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--']))
+def run(name,recipe):
+    folder=OUT/name;folder.mkdir()
+    results=ROOT/'rules-engine/build/test-results/test'
+    if results.exists():shutil.rmtree(results)
+    started=time.time_ns()
+    with (folder/'output.log').open('wb') as f:
+        rc=subprocess.run(['just','--working-directory',str(ROOT),'--justfile',str(HERE/'validation.just'),recipe],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
+    (folder/'exit.txt').write_text(str(rc))
+    (folder/'TIMING.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(started_ns=started,ended_ns=time.time_ns())))
+    if results.exists():shutil.copytree(results,folder/'junit')
+    save(folder/'FORM.kt',TARGET.read_bytes())
+    return stage(folder)
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);bind('initial')
+    for f in HERE.iterdir():

+package com.wingedsheep.engine.scenarios
+
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.core.*
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.ZoneKey
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.battlefield.ReplacementEffectSourceComponent
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.player.ManaPoolComponent
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.state.components.stack.ChosenTarget
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.support.GameTestDriver
+import com.wingedsheep.engine.support.TestCards
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.core.*
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.dsl.*
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.model.*
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.AbilityCost
+import com.wingedsheep.sdk.scripting.ReplaceLifePaymentWithLibraryExile
+import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
+import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
+
+/** Deliberate mutation witnesses; never registered as production cards. */
+class ActivatedPhyrexianPaymentControlTest : FunSpec({
+    fun fixture(costValue: AbilityCost = Costs.Mana("{U/P}"), targeted: Boolean = false) = card("Manual Payment Boundary Fixture") {
+        manaCost = "{2}"
+        typeLine = "Artifact Creature — Construct"
+        power = 0
+        toughness = 4
+        activatedAbility {
+            cost = costValue
+            if (targeted) target("creature", Targets.Creature)
+            effect = Effects.GainLife(1)
+        }
+    }
+    fun driver(f: CardDefinition) = GameTestDriver().also {
+        it.registerCards(TestCards.all + listOf(f))
+        it.initMirrorMatch(Deck.of("Island" to 40))
+        it.passPriorityUntil(Step.PRECOMBAT_MAIN)
+        it.putCreatureOnBattlefield(it.player1, f.name)
+    }
+    fun action(d: GameTestDriver, f: CardDefinition, choices: List<Color> = listOf(Color.BLUE), repeat: Int = 1): ActivateAbility {
+        val id = d.state.getBattlefield().single()
+        return ActivateAbility(d.player1, id, f.activatedAbilities.single().id,
+            paymentStrategy = PaymentStrategy.Explicit(emptyList(), choices), repeatCount = repeat)
+    }
+    fun blue(d: GameTestDriver) = d.state.getEntity(d.player1)?.get<ManaPoolComponent>()?.blue ?: 0
+    fun unchanged(d: GameTestDriver, a: ActivateAbility) {
+        val before = d.state
+        val r = d.submit(a)
+        r.isSuccess shouldBe false
+        r.newState shouldBe before
+        r.events shouldBe emptyList()
+        d.state shouldBe before
+    }
+    test("APC life payment without blue") {
+        val f = fixture(); val d = driver(f)
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f))
+        r.error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 18
+    }
+    test("APC choice preserves blue") {
+        val f = fixture(); val d = driver(f); d.giveMana(d.player1, Color.BLUE, 1)
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f))
+        r.error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 18
+        blue(d) shouldBe 1
+    }
+    test("APC invalid color rejected") {
+        val f = fixture(); val d = driver(f); d.giveMana(d.player1, Color.BLUE, 1)
+        val before = d.state
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f, listOf(Color.RED)))
+        r.isSuccess shouldBe false
+        r.newState shouldBe before; r.events shouldBe emptyList()
+    }
+    test("APC insufficient life rejected") {
+        val f = fixture(); val d = driver(f); d.setLifeTotal(d.player1, 1)
+        val before = d.state
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f))
+        r.isSuccess shouldBe false
+        r.newState shouldBe before; r.events shouldBe emptyList()
+    }
+    test("APC payment emits one exact event") {
+        val f = fixture(); val d = driver(f)
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f))
+        r.error shouldBe null
+        val paid = r.events.filterIsInstance<LifeChangedEvent>().filter { it.reason == LifeChangeReason.PAYMENT }
+        paid.size shouldBe 1
+        paid.single().playerId shouldBe d.player1
+        paid.single().oldLife shouldBe 20
+        paid.single().newLife shouldBe 18
+    }
+    test("APC repeated payment charges each activation") {
+        val f = fixture(); val d = driver(f)
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f, repeat = 3))
+        r.error shouldBe null
+        d.getLifeTotal(d.player1) shouldBe 14
+        d.state.stack.size shouldBe 3
+    }
+    test("APC aggregate life cost rejected") {
+        val f = fixture(Costs.Composite(Costs.Mana("{U/P}"), Costs.PayLife(3)))
+        val d = driver(f); d.setLifeTotal(d.player1, 4)
+        val before = d.state
+        val r = d.submit(action(d, f))
+        r.isSuccess shouldBe false
+        r.newState shouldBe before; r.events shouldBe emptyList()
+    }
+})
